author: bald and bankrupt
description: When you travel the backroads of the former USSR you hear towns mentioned by ranndom strangers you meet in platskart and marshrutkas. Ming-Kush was one such town I had heard of a few times. A formerly closed Soviet town that mined uranium, it had subsequently fallen into disrepair when the Union collapsed. Well, that was music to my ears. Let's go together on an adventure into Soviet Cental Asia...
title: 24 Hours In An Abandoned Soviet City
